note: Each configuration changes one variable from the Skia default. Every variable was checked in the WPE WebKit 2.54.0 source (see docs/tilecast-edge-wpe-compositor-lab.md). Combine variables only after the single-variable runs say what each one changes.

baseline.name: skia-show-damage
baseline.visualOnly: paints a damage overlay into the presented frames; watch the screen or film it

extended.name: skia-cpu-painting-1
extended.note: CPU painting threads apply only with CPU rendering; compare with skia-cpu

extended.name: buffer-linear-xrgb
extended.note: DRM_FORMAT_XRGB8888 with DRM_FORMAT_MOD_LINEAR for the view's buffers

extended.name: vblank-timer
extended.note: WebKit paces frames with a timer instead of the DRM vblank monitor

extended.name: drm-legacy-kms
extended.note: WPEPlatform DRM uses drmModePageFlip instead of atomic commits
